**Done.** `thumbnail_format` has been set to **`webp`**.

**Why webp?**
- It is the **smallest** of the three supported formats at **20 KB** per thumbnail.
- Compatibility tests confirm it works across all target browsers and the image pipeline — no trade-offs needed.
